acceptance_tests: B2 uses advisor/b1-gate.json and the final B1 exact ordered Gram/current bytes; stale Round18 P or face-only Gram is rejected.
The continuous box |lambda_f|<=alpha/8 is covered for all signs and all faces, not selected fixtures only.
The P-Omega compressed magnetic form on faces plus six-cycles is explicitly bounded; the old Round18 3alpha diagonal block is not reused for the enlarged P.
Cross terms from Q are controlled with the accepted B1 W^*W Gram or a rigorously stated fallback; PV2P without PVP subtraction is rejected.
The proof provides E1 lower and E0 upper as separate min-max/Rayleigh statements and derives the gap direction correctly.
The declared positive E_star is checked directly; E_star=0, kappa, tolerance or Fibonacci labels are rejected even when ratios remain syntactically present.
Round18 r=3/8 is reported only as rederived, rejected, limited or open for the enlarged P; historical benchmark text is not an acceptance proof.
Normal and optimized outputs are deterministic and counted once.
Independent comparison reconstructs interval bounds and rejects producer pass booleans, source hashes alone and sampled Ritz gaps.
falsifying_controls: Replace the 48-channel B1 P by the old 12-channel face-only projector and require rejection.
Use a constant 3alpha lower block for all P-Omega states and require rejection because six-cycles have H0=9alpha/2 and nonzero compressed magnetic couplings.
Omit face-six or six-six PVP terms and require rejection on a fixture where they are nonzero.
Use PV2P or a conservative norm bound as exact W^*W and require rejection.
Claim r=3/8 from Round18 without rederiving it under the enlarged P and require rejection.
Promote a finite sampled/Ritz eigenvalue over coefficient fixtures to a continuous box theorem and require rejection.
Set E_star=0 or use kappa/tolerance/Fibonacci index as physical energy reference while leaving ratios unchanged and require rejection.
Mix E1 lower and E0 upper signs so that an upper bound is treated as a lower bound and require rejection.
Delete one coefficient-box extreme or interval cell in the independent comparison and require rejection.
goal: Goal B loop 2: continuous finite two-cube coefficient box using the accepted B1 48-channel projector and exact full ordered cross Gram

mathematical_target.E0_upper: Give a separate upper bound for lambda_0(H), at minimum the vacuum Rayleigh bound E0 <= 0. Do not collapse E1 lower and E0 upper into a Ritz gap.
mathematical_target.E1_lower: Give a rigorous lower bound for lambda_1(H) from a codimension-one min-max argument on Omega^perp. The bound must combine the 47-dimensional compressed P-Omega block, the Q threshold, and cross term controlled by the B1 ordered Gram.
mathematical_target.benchmark: Evaluate the old Round18 r=3/8 benchmark only as a benchmark. Preserve the old value R*(3/8)=0.11876245 as historical, not as a Round19 theorem unless rederived with the enlarged 48-channel P block.
mathematical_target.gap_conclusion: A gap lower bound is admitted only as E1_lower - E0_upper with the sign/direction stated. If E0_upper=0 and E1_lower>0, report gap >= E1_lower.
mathematical_target.minimum_continuous_box: At least prove positivity on |lambda_f| <= alpha/8 or return limited/rejected with the exact failed premise. A valid crude fallback lower bound for this box is (25-sqrt(265))*alpha/8 if the sharper full-Gram calculation fails, but the loop must still report how the accepted B1 Gram was used or why it did not improve the bound.
mathematical_target.statement: Prove a finite-graph interacting gap lower bound on the signed coefficient box |lambda_f| <= alpha/8 using the B1 complete P, exact PVP data and exact W^*W cross Gram.

non_claims: B2 is finite two-cube only and does not prove homogeneous dense stability, limiting spectral passage, continuum Yang-Mills or the Clay mass gap.
A static kappa coefficient box is not a physical time-generator or energy-scale match.
A plot or sampled matrix eigenvalue is not a continuous coefficient-box proof.

physical_contract.block_structure: On Omega^perp use faces at H0=3 alpha, six-cycles at H0=9 alpha/2, and Q at H0>=6 alpha. Do not reuse the Round18 constant 3 alpha P-Omega block.
physical_contract.coefficient_box: Primary acceptance target is the continuous signed box |lambda_f| <= alpha/8 for all 11 faces. Larger boxes, including the Round18 r=3/8 benchmark, may be evaluated only with certified inequalities and must not be assumed.
physical_contract.graph: same actual adjacent two-cube SU(2) graph as B1: 12 vertices, 20 links, 11 signed faces including the shared internal face
physical_contract.hamiltonian: H = alpha * sum_e C_e - sum_f lambda_f x_f on the physical Gauss-invariant Hilbert space, with x_f=ReTr(U_f)/2
physical_contract.projector: Use the accepted B1 strict-cutoff projector P of dimension 48: Omega plus 11 four-edge fundamental cycles and 36 six-edge fundamental cycles. Q=1-P has H0 threshold at 6 alpha.
physical_contract.scale: E_star > 0 remains a declared physical reference; use alpha/E_star=2 for the checkpoint and report lambda_f/alpha separately. Static kappa, tolerances, volume and Fibonacci labels are rejected as physical energy references even if ratios are numerically present.

backward: independently reconstruct the B2 block argument from the accepted B1 gate and exact Gram rather than importing the forward optimizer
verify the P-Omega block split faces/six-cycles/Q and reject the old constant-3-alpha Round18 block shortcut
independently certify coefficient-box bounds over |lambda_f|<=alpha/8, including any interval or branch-and-bound arithmetic
check that E1 lower and E0 upper are separate min-max statements and that no Ritz/sample matrix gap is promoted
compare producer evidence with exact hashes and mutation controls
forward: load or copy the accepted B1 gate inputs without mutating them
construct the 47-dimensional P-Omega compressed operator with face and six-cycle H0 levels 3 and 9/2 in alpha units
use the exact B1 PVP coefficients and exact ordered W^*W coefficients to derive certified bounds over |lambda_f|<=alpha/8
derive a codimension-one E1 lower bound and a separate E0 upper bound; state the resulting finite-graph gap lower bound
evaluate but do not assume the Round18 r=3/8 benchmark under the enlarged P; if inconclusive, record it as open
produce exact rational/radical or interval certificates, source manifest, normal/optimized deterministic outputs and wrong-model controls

stop_condition: Stop after a source-bound B2 gate accepts, limits or rejects the continuous finite two-cube box. Do not freeze Goal C loop 1 from B2 plans alone; C must separately mark static kappa integrals as physical-scale-unmatched unless a real physical scale match is supplied.
